description.value: You move to provide immediate care to those who need it. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Stride], then use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Battle Medicine] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Treat Poison]. You can spend 2 actions for Doctor's Visitation to instead Stride and then use either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Administer First Aid] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Treat Condition] (if you have that feat).

You provide emotional and spiritual care. Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied], and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned] to the list of conditions you can reduce with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Treat Condition]. If the stunned condition has a duration instead of a value, you can't use Treat Condition to reduce it.

You become an expert in Medicine. When you succeed with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Battle Medicine] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Treat Wounds], the target gains a circumstance bonus to the number of Hit Points they regain equal to 5 HP at DC 20, 10 HP at DC 30, or 15 HP at DC 40.

Once per day, you can use Battle Medicine on a creature that's temporarily immune due to having already been treated with Battle Medicine. If you're a master in Medicine, you can do so once per hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.XWkyCVISmVtJ0ZY3]{Medic}

Requirements You are holding healer's tools or are wearing them and have a hand free.

You resuscitate the dead. Attempt a @Check[medicine|dc:40|showDC:all] check to revive a dead creature who has been dead for no more than 3 rounds and whose body is mostly intact. If you succeed, the target returns to life with the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Raise Dead], except it still has the wounded condition it had before dying, increased by 1 (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Wounded]{Wounded 1} if it wasn't wounded before dying). Whether you succeed or fail, the target is temporarily immune to Resuscitate for 1 day.

Requirements You are holding healer's tools, or you are wearing them and have a hand free.

You treat an adjacent creature in an attempt to reduce the clumsy, enfeebled, or sickened condition. If a creature has multiple conditions from this list, choose one. Attempt a counteract check against the condition using your Medicine modifier as your counteract modifier and the condition's source to determine the DC. You can't treat a condition that came from an artifact or effect above 20th level unless you have Legendary Medic; even if you do, the counteract DC increases by 10. Treating a Condition that is continually applied under certain circumstances (for instance, the enfeebled condition a holy character gains from carrying a weapon with the unholy rune) has no effect as long as the circumstances continue.

Critical Success Reduce the condition value by 2.

Success Reduce the condition value by 1.

Critical Failure Increase the condition value by 1.
